messages:
marta: quick sync — onboarding quant4v2 for the long-summary pipeline. want to bake in entropy and KL checks in addition to embedding / rouge.
josh: baseline prod metrics: ROUGE-L 43.0, embed cos 0.875, avg token entropy 3.12, hallucination 1.5%. (sample 3k)
rachel: shadow run (quant4v2): ROUGE-L 42.2 (-0.8), embed cos 0.865 (-0.010), avg entropy 2.98 (-0.14), hallucination 2.6% (n=500). lower entropy but higher hallucination on finance/legal slices.
sree: lower entropy + higher hallucination smells like overconfident decoding after quantization. need a calibration check (temperature sweep) and KL divergence between softmax distributions on seed set. set KL threshold tight.
marta: proposed gating logic: require all pass to move past shadow: embedding centroid cosine delta <= 0.012, KL avg <= 0.02, entropy drop <= 0.2, hallucination absolute delta <= 0.004. per-slice stricter for legal/finance.
josh: rollout plan: 0.2% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with hold windows [60,120,240,720,1440] minutes. slice ramp slower for sensitive slices. auto-rollback if any check trips at a step. also add p95 latency gate: abort if >15% increase.
sree: prefer statistical test on KL and embedding (bootstrap, alpha=0.05), min_samples 300 for the early steps.
marta: included a fallback variant: quant4-late-temp (same weights but decoding with temp=1.1) as immediate fallback to reduce overconfidence. route traffic to fallback automatically on gate fail.
ops-bot: deploy job queued: rollout/1778001234; webhook: https://deploy.internal/rollout/1778001234
rachel: I'll run temperature sweep and targeted slice eval today; will post CSV.
josh: also instrument token-level confidence histogram for p50/p90/p99, want to see drift at tail.
sree: once the harness + sweep pass, ops to enable shadow->0.2% next maintenance window. who signs off?
marta: i'll sign off if harness shows KL <=0.02 and hallucination delta under 0.4% absolute on 3k sample.
ops-bot: oncall notified: @oncall-eng-ml.

marta: thanks all — will update thread with harness outputs. :party_parrot:
